groupings.title: MRFoundry: AI for MRI science
groupings.description: Connect MRI domain knowledge, scientific tools and project memory. Navigate methods and primary sources across acquisition, reconstruction, analysis, hardware and publishing; retain scoped lessons for later work.

groupings.title: Research workflow: question to evidence
groupings.description: Plan studies, run controlled experiments, inspect evidence and prepare reproducible reports and manuscripts. Connect research decisions to checks and reusable lessons.

groupings.title: Specialist skills
groupings.description: Task-focused MRI guidance; install one or the collection. mri-reconstruction runs established tools such as BART/SigPy.
